notes.title: Mad Snowboarding released for Linux
notes.content:
Mad Snowboarding released for Linux! Thanks to Ari El Uno and ultra h4x0r for consulting me about Linux and SSL! You two guys made it possible to release Mad Snowboarding so quickly on Linux ;)

Mac OS version of Mad Snowboarding is coming in October. I'm sorry for the delay, but I will have no time till end of September, because of a job that I will have to do.

notes.title: First patch is out
notes.content:
Patch 1 (10.09.15):
- fix: community levels were not playable if the game was not installed on the C:\ partition
- fix: level selection was freezing if many community levels were downloaded at the same time

Big thanks to MadDoggyca! He reported these bugs, stayed awake for the half of the night, shared his screen with me and helped me to find these bugs!
